about: Hardcore route rules for tools/guide_draft.py --hardcore (docs/HARDCORE.md). Quest IDs are from the data pack; every rule names where it comes from and how sure that source is. A skip becomes '#skipquest <id> >> <reason>'; a note becomes a '.note' after the quest's '.accept'. Corrected from play (the contributors' deaths) over time.

rules.name: Skull Rock
rules.reason: hardcore: cave with respawning enemies and a hard-hitting boss; kills a large share of players
rules.source: Blizzard forums, 'Advice on dangerous Horde quests to avoid in HC + SF' (several posters); dotesports top-10 hardcore quests to avoid
